metadata.title: Mixed Question Types Conformance Test
metadata.description: Valid SciVault-QF 0.1 question set containing several supported question types.
metadata.author: SciVault

questions.question: Which of the following are vector quantities?
questions.explanation: Velocity and acceleration have both magnitude and direction.

questions.question: An object moving at constant velocity has zero acceleration.
questions.explanation: Constant velocity means the velocity is not changing, so the acceleration is zero.

questions.question: Name the SI unit of force.
questions.explanation: The SI unit of force is the newton, symbol N.

questions.question: The SI unit of electric current is the {{blank}}.
questions.explanation: The SI base unit of electric current is the ampere, symbol A.

questions.question: A car travels $100\,\mathrm{m}$ in $5\,\mathrm{s}$. What is its average speed in $\mathrm{m/s}$?
questions.explanation: Average speed is distance divided by elapsed time: $100/5=20\,\mathrm{m/s}$.
